mapper.select: SELECT product_id AS productId, product_name AS productName, price, brand, created_at AS createdAt FROM products WHERE product_name LIKE #{keywordLike} ORDER BY product_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT product_id AS productId, product_name AS productName, price, brand, created_at AS createdAt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY product_id DESC) AS rn FROM products WHERE product_name LIKE #{keywordLike} ) t WHERE t.rn BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
SELECT product_id AS productId, product_name AS productName, price, brand, created_at AS createdAt FROM products WHERE product_id = #{id}
